title: TriggerMC
description: TriggerMC is a simple but competitive Minecraft network built for players who enjoy survival-based gameplay and grinding with friends.
body:
Who are we?
TriggerMC is a simple but competitive Minecraft network built for players who enjoy survival-based gameplay and grinding with friends.

What do we have?
⇨ Lifesteal SMP (main mode)
⇨ More gamemodes coming soon as the server grows

(TriggerMC is available for both JAVA Edition and BEDROCK/POCKET Edition of Minecraft)

◆ JAVA IP: play.triggermc.fun
◆ Bedrock IP: play.triggermc.fun
◆ Bedrock Port: 19135

Join in, play with others, and see how far you can go on the leaderboard.
